study_design: Hospital-based case-control comparison of prostate cancer patients and controls
reason: The study compares serum biomarkers among men with clinical or focal prostate cancer and controls. Although biomarker levels varied by disease stage, the risk analysis does not define or analyze aggressive incident prostate cancer.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: When the serum retinol level was considered in quintile classes, there was a statistically significant (P less than 0.05) trend of increased prostatic cancer risk associated with decreasing serum retinol levels.
estimate_classifications.reason: The retinol trend concerns prostatic cancer risk overall. Mention of variation by disease stage does not establish an aggressive incident endpoint.
